gbm_population_evidence.quote: the pathological examination confirmed glioblastoma with isocitrate dehydrogenase (IDH) wild-type according to the 2021 World Health Organization (WHO) classification of tumors of the central nervous system

candidate_evidence.quote: Tislelizumab will be given 300 mg intravenously every 4 weeks beginning on Day 1 of Cycle 2 of adjuvant TMZ.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: TTField in Combination With Temozolomide and Tislelizumab in The Treatment of Newly Diagnosed Glioblastoma.
Patients who had undergone maximal surgical resection (biopsy) and completed TMZ concurrent chemoradiotherapy were planned for adjuvant TMZ treatment.

role_evidence.quote: To investigate the safety and efficacy of Tumor-Treating Fields (TTFields) in combined with temozolomide (TMZ) and tislelizumab in the treatment of newly diagnosed glioblastoma (GBM).
The patients will carry out 6 cycles of TMZ adjuvant chemotherapy according to the instructions.

agents.drug_class_hint: alkylating agent, GBM standard of care

source_quote.quote: the pathological examination confirmed glioblastoma with isocitrate dehydrogenase (IDH) wild-type

coder_notes: Single-arm: TTFields (device, not listed as agent) + standard adjuvant TMZ + tislelizumab. Tislelizumab is the only investigational drug; TTFields arguably also part of the investigational combination but is a device. IDH-wildtype only defines GBM.
